Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in data synthesis and logical reasoning during the final step. Specifically, the Planner incorrectly calculated the "scope" of Delmer Daves by excluding his role as a "producer" because it was not explicitly listed in the Britannica snippet, despite the Wikipedia source clearly stating he was a "film producer." This led to an artificial tie (2 roles each) which was then resolved using a flawed metric (directorial credit count) that contradicted the actual definition of "scope of profession" (which refers to the variety of roles, not the volume of work in one role). The Planner failed to correctly aggregate the available evidence (Wikipedia + Britannica) to show Daves had 3 roles and Rosen had 2, leading to the wrong conclusion that Rosen had a broader scope.
